cohort: The study included 299 neonates born to mothers with ICP, with a comparative analysis performed between 150 term ICP neonates and 150 term controls without complications.
finding: Neonates born to mothers with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) exhibit distinct perturbations in amino acid and acylcarnitine metabolism, with specific elevated and decreased metabolite levels suggesting disruptions in fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial function.
gest_age: The ICP cohort included both preterm (46.2%) and term infants, with comparative analyses focused on term infants.
